children: chief executive and executive chairman David Foulkes
his retirement, effective at the end of this year after two decades at the marine manufacturer.
Aine Denari, currently serving as Brunswick’s
chief technology officer and executive vice president and president of Navico Group, has been named as Foulkes successor as CEO.
Denari will also join the board on January 1, 2027, while David Everitt, currently the company’s lead independent director, will assume the role of non-executive chairman at the same time.
Foulkes’ retirement does not seem to be going over well with investors despite the 29% erosion in Brunswick’s
share price during the past five years of his tenure. Shares dropped by more than 3% in premarket and opened on Monday at a 10-month low.
